failed: The board could not be read.

quote.flagHint: A prediction only: the OTO order is created anyway.

inspector.dotsHint: Dots: delivered · shown · opened, with the time since offer. Tills: online / signed in when offered.
inspector.locked: Locked at <s>{{store}}</s>: no line edits, item cancels or store cancel.

release.title: Release lock
release.explain: Release the lock on delivery <d>{{delivery}}</d>. This cannot be undone.
release.explainHeld: Release the lock that holds delivery <d>{{delivery}}</d> at <s>{{store}}</s>. This cannot be undone: the delivery can then be changed or moved to another store.

refusal.reasonMissing: The release needs one of the listed reasons.
refusal.noteMissing: A release for another reason needs a note.
refusal.notLocked: This delivery is no longer locked: it was already released, or it is closed.

release.noMove: Releasing the lock does not free a store move on this delivery: an express delivery keeps its store once its OTO order exists. To get out of it, cancel the delivery.

roadShadow.title: Road distance (Shadow)
roadShadow.subtitle: What deciding callouts by road would have changed, on the deliveries measured in Shadow. Counts only.
roadShadow.incomplete: Pick both days of the range.
roadShadow.failedTitle: The Shadow report could not be read

fallbacks.title: Fell back to straight line
fallbacks.totalShare: <v>{{share}}</v> of the deliveries in this range
fallbacks.high: Fallbacks are high: check the key and the quota before switching on

TIMEOUT.label: Google timed out
TIMEOUT.hint: If it persists, raise GoogleRoutes:TimeoutSeconds to 4 or 5. Each second is added to every delivery create.

QUOTA.label: Daily quota reached
QUOTA.hint: Raise the cap, after checking the billing alert and that the volume is real.

KEY.label: The key was refused
KEY.hint: Fix the key or its IP list. IT confirms SIS.Api's outbound IP.

HTTP_ERROR.label: Google answered with an error
HTTP_ERROR.hint: Check Google's status page and SIS.Api's HTTP log for service GoogleRoutes.

BAD_RESPONSE.label: Google's answer could not be read
BAD_RESPONSE.hint: Check Google's status page and SIS.Api's HTTP log for service GoogleRoutes.

ERROR.label: Unexpected error
ERROR.hint: Check Google's status page and SIS.Api's HTTP log for service GoogleRoutes.

NOT_CONFIGURED.label: No key on this host
NOT_CONFIGURED.hint: Place the key in this host's config and recycle SIS.Api.

median.title: Median road / straight
median.hint: About <v>{{normal}}</v> is normal in a city; much higher means long detours

empty.title: No Shadow callouts in this range. Is the type set to Shadow?
